title: Satisfaction of propagated labels
statement: Let $G$ be a finite unique game, and choose a root label for each connected component. Propagate these labels to vertices by transporting each component's root label along the chosen paths from its root. The resulting vertex labeling satisfies every constraint if and only if, in every component, its chosen root label satisfies the compatibility condition for every constraint whose source lies in that component.
hypotheses_covered: A finite unique game with finite nonempty vertex and constraint sets, distinct endpoints, and a permutation attached to each constraint
A root label for each connected component
